facts.fact: The OGP commitment page states that government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021 on open public data sets technical specifications for the national open data portal and requires an inventory of priority public data.
facts.system: Decree no. 2021-3 on open public data

facts.fact: The IRM 2021-2023 results text says a new version of the national open data portal, built to the decree's specifications, was launched in early March 2023.

The IRM text says the portal carried datasets from 23 data producers across 6 themes (consulted April 2024), and that the e-government unit reported about 296 datasets identified by over 40 public entities in the inventory system by end 2023.

systems.owner: Unité de l'administration électronique, Présidence du gouvernement

facts.fact: The IRM text says the national open data portal, run by the e-government unit of the Presidency of the Government, offered open datasets from 23 data producers across 6 themes as of April 2024.
The IRM text says 23 data producers published on the portal as of April 2024.
The IRM text reports 5 data reuses and 233 open data requests on the portal, and a 2023 Open Gov Data Hack run by the e-government unit with the health, social affairs and education ministries.
